title_cn: 玻利维亚总统帕兹任命莫拉莱斯为新任财务主管，优先考虑新贷款
summary: Bolivia’s President Rodrigo Paz named Christian Andrés Morales as his new finance minister with a charge to work with international lenders to secure as much as $10 billion in new financing.
